599:t_128:0.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$! You are snuffing out humanity's possibilities!」

599:t_128:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$マリーダ・クルス$$. Even you oppose me.」

599:t_128:2.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「I have staked everything on the light that leads to the future! The light that will not lose to your void!」

599:t_128:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「That is an illusion, $$マリーダ$$. It is a somewhat rough method, but this $$ネオ・ジオング$$ will teach you that by force.」

599:t_129:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「There is no peace in the world you would lead.」

599:t_129:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Let me hear your reasoning.」

599:t_129:2.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「It's simple. A man who doesn't understand the weight of human life understands neither the meaning nor the value of peace.」

599:t_129:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「That's why, $$フル・フロンタル$$... I won't hand the world over to you...!」

599:t_130:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「A machine that sacrifices mobility for firepower is an easy target for me!」

599:t_130:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「But once you enter this $$ネオ・ジオング$$'s range, there is no escape.」

599:t_130:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「Don't think the world or I will do as you please! My wings will fly beyond your expectations!」

599:t_131:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「You're bottling up your feelings! Let them all out and listen to my soooong!!」

599:t_131:2.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Try singing your own song, not someone else's! It'll feel a whole lot better!」

599:t_131:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「It seems you deny my very existence.」

599:t_132:0.en:
$$レド$$
「You're doing the same thing as $$ストライカー#pilot$$! You're using pleasant-sounding words to steal people's freedom!」

599:t_132:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Whether one sees it as domination or stable governance depends on the person. I, at least, try to be a good guide.」

599:t_132:2.en:
$$レド$$
「A man who sends in the military to crush his opponents by force is no good ruler!」

599:t_132:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「It seems you, too, cannot accept me through reason.」

599:t_132:4.en:
$$レド$$
「I believe in what I feel! And those feelings tell me you're my enemy!」

599:t_133:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「Coming onto the battlefield yourself, as the leader, was your greatest tactical mistake.」

599:t_133:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Soldiers will not follow a man who never stands on the front line.」

599:t_133:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「That arrogance will put an end to your ambition!」

599:t_133:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You can say that after you defeat me...」

599:t_133:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「You're full of openings! Your other mistake is talking too much on the battlefield!」

599:t_134:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I think my methods are gentler than your $$ゼロ・レクイエム$$.」

599:t_134:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I agree. But I cannot accept a method that avoids pain by stealing hope from people's future.」

599:t_134:2.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I cannot indulge your romantic ideals... and neither can humanity.」

599:t_134:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Each individual must make that choice, rather than you or me.」

599:t_134:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I, too, will fight to stop you from stealing even that freedom, as one of the people living in this world!」

599:t_135:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「An $$ＡＴ$$ pilot who can live only in battle would never accept the world I would lead.」

599:t_135:2.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I will stop you of my own free will. You cannot create a future.」

599:t_136:0.en:
$$桂$$
「I can't stand guys who bring out an obvious secret weapon just because it's the final showdown.」

599:t_136:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Just as I am a vessel for humanity's collective will, this $$ネオ・ジオング$$ is a vessel for people's wishes.」

599:t_136:2.en:
$$桂$$
「Then let's break that vessel of yours! With a nice, big crash!」

599:t_136:4.en:
$$桂$$
「Thinking you've already won like that is one of a villain's bad habits!」

599:t_136:5.en:
$$桂$$
「Get ready, $$フル・フロンタル$$! Your story ends here!」

599:t_137:0.en:
$n
「You're a bigger target now, so my attacks will hit! Then I'll overpower you!」

599:t_137:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「How naive. You will pay for underestimating this $$ネオ・ジオング$$'s firepower.」

599:t_137:2.en:
$n
「Your ego seems to have grown along with your machine.」

599:t_137:3.en:
$n
「I'll knock down that machine you're so proud of and shatter your confidence!」

599:t_137:4.en:
$n
「That's how I'll stop you and this war right here!」

599:t_138:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「$$バナージ・リンクス$$! Today, I will...!」

599:t_138:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Why can't you understand the danger of fighting over personal grudges like that!?」

599:t_138:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「We... humanity... don't have the luxury of doing that!」

599:t_138:3.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「We have no further use for that $$ガンダム$$! You've repeatedly insulted the Colonel, and I'll finish you here!」

599:t_138:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Can't my voice reach you...!?」

599:t_138:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But I...! I can't stop moving forward here!!」

599:t_139:2.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You, the $$ユニコーン$$, $$シャア$$, $$アムロ$$... I'll eliminate every one of the Colonel's enemies!」

599:t_139:3.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「You...! Will you fight only for $$フロンタル$$ to the very end!?」

599:t_140:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「This is as far as you go, $$セツコ$$! I can't let you advance any further!」

599:t_140:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$バルビエル$$...! I won't hesitate to fight you!」

599:t_140:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「If my $$スフィア$$ can stop yours, I'll use it!」

599:t_140:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'll overcome my sorrow...! I won't let you spread hatred any further!」

599:t_141:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Even as we speak, your beloved Miss $$スズネ$$ is fading away inside $$アムブリエル$$.」

599:t_141:3.en:
$n
「You're just like $$ギルター$$. You can't win head-on, so you use cowardly tricks to shake people up emotionally.」

599:t_141:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Do you think I'll fall for such an obvious provocation?」

599:t_141:5.en:
$n
「Don't lump me in with you. I don't intend to use cheap tricks like that.」

599:t_141:6.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You little...! Quit running your mouth!」

599:t_141:7.en:
$n
「Are you ready, $$バルビエル$$!? I'll crush you head-on!!」
